name: Protopasta Static Dissipative PETG @base
filament_notes:
Static Dissipative PETG. TDS: 250-290C, 70-80C plate, up to 8 mm3/s, 0.4 mm or larger nozzle; drying highly recommended (65C for 6 hours). Material Data Table: 250C up to 12 mm3/s, 80C plate. This profile uses the table's 12 mm3/s cap; the TDS only goes up to 8 mm3/s.
Use Magigoo or glue stick so prints don't fuse to the plate.
